title: 订单已提交，为什么还没处理完？
scope: One source-backed path: task data becomes bytes in a partition append log; client fetches by position, application separately executes and stores business completion. No Sender-batch, committed-offset recovery, replication or idempotence survey.
example: Fictional notification task E01/order7042, orders/P0, explicit UTF-8 strings, compression none, one retained record.
